scope: Preference client lifecycle during pending cache writes, TypeScript and Flutter

firstFix.behavior: Disposal before durable storage completes prevents subsequent transport dispatch; original scoped command remains available only for explicit retry.

lateStorageFailure.behavior: A storage error delivered after disposal does not replace disposed state or notify closed listeners. Conflict-resolution operations continue to reject storage failure.

limits: No production preference activation or new authority
Native CI is not physical-device acceptance
Global host binding, dashboard contract and broader pending-command lifecycle acceptance remain open
